Closed-loop simulation for full-duplex voice agents面向全双工语音智能体的闭环仿真环境

InteractionGymTo train your voice agent.训练你的语音智能体

Simulated users that hear your agent and react, on one reproducible clock. Use it to evaluate, to generate rollouts, and to train with online RL.

模拟用户听得见你的智能体并做出反应，一切运行在同一个可复现的时钟上。可用于评测、生成 rollout，以及在线强化学习训练。

What it does功能

One environment, from evaluation to training

同一个环境，从评测到训练

Simulate仿真

Users that answer, interrupt, backchannel, pause and talk to others, with voices, noise and tools that take time.

用户会回答、打断、附和、停顿、和旁人说话；有音色、环境噪声，以及需要时间的工具调用。

Evaluate评测

Run benchmarks open loop (replayed) and closed loop (a user that reacts) from the same start. Every user turn gets a timed score.

同一个开头，分别跑开环（回放）和闭环（会反应的用户）。每个用户回合都有带时间的分数。

Roll outRollout

Seeded episodes, faster than real time, in parallel. Fork an episode into branches from the same state for group rollouts.

可设种子、快于实时、大规模并行。可以从同一状态把一局分叉成多条分支，用于分组 rollout。

Train with online RL在线 RL 训练

Scores are rewards in [0, 1], stamped with time and turn, so credit goes to the moment that earned it.

分数即奖励，范围 [0, 1]，带时间和回合编号，奖励可以归到对应的时刻。

config→episodes→trajectory→scores · reports · rewards分数 · 报告 · 奖励
How it's built结构

A small kernel. Everything else is a plugin.

内核很小，其余都是插件

Your patch你的补丁

Change one row for one experiment.

为一次实验改一行配置。

Bundles配置包

A benchmark or a training setup, written as YAML.

一个 benchmark 或一套训练配置，用 YAML 写成。

Plugins插件

Built in, or from your own package.

内置，或来自你自己的包。

Kernel内核

Simulated clock, streams, trajectory format.

模拟时钟、数据流、轨迹格式。

Users, behaviours, agents, model backends, tools, tasks, scorers and drivers are all plugins. Any role can be the one under test, and every episode records the full configuration that produced it.

用户、行为、智能体、模型后端、工具、任务、评分器和运行方式都是插件。任何角色都可以作为被评测方；每一局都会记录生成它的完整配置。

rolebehaviouragentbackendtooltaskscorersinkdriver

Python functions, an API or an existing benchmark become tools through one adapter. Calls take simulated time, and the world state forks with the episode.

Python 函数、API 或现有 benchmark，都通过一个适配器变成工具。调用需要模拟时间，世界状态随对话一起分叉。

Get started开始使用

One file sets up the whole conversation

一份配置，定义整场对话

Modules模块
  • role/*who takes part参与者
  • source/*what a simulated role says模拟角色说什么
  • behaviour/*noise, asides, listening噪声、旁白、倾听
  • backend/*LLM, TTS, ASR callsLLM、TTS、ASR 调用
  • agent/*the policy under test被评测的策略
  • tool/*tools and their world工具及其世界状态
  • task/*where episodes come from对话任务来源
  • scorer/*scores and rewards分数与奖励
  • sink/*files, viewer pages输出文件、查看页面
  • driver/*concurrency, resume, A/B arms并发、续跑、A/B 分组

Each row of the file picks one plugin and sets its config. Rows refer to each other by id. ig plugins <kind> lists every plugin with its fields.

文件里每一行选一个插件并写它的配置，行之间用 id 互相引用。ig plugins <类型> 列出所有插件及其配置项。

# my_run.yml  ·  run it with:  ig run my_run.yml --seeds 0,1,2
- extends: core                   # kernel limits, scorers, sinks, driver

- insert:
  # ── models ──────────────────────────────────────────
  - id: user_llm
    plugin: backend/chat
    config: {base_url: "${IG_LLM_URL}", model: Qwen3.8-27B}
  - id: tts
    plugin: backend/tts
    config: {base_url: "${IG_TTS_URL}"}

  # ── the simulated user ──────────────────────────────
  - id: lines                     # what the user says
    plugin: source/llm
    config: {llm: user_llm}
  - id: noise                     # what else happens around it
    plugin: behaviour/noise
  - id: asides
    plugin: behaviour/asides
  - id: user
    plugin: role/user
    config:
      source: lines
      listener: user_llm          # listen, backchannel or cut in
      voice: {tts: tts}
      behaviours: [noise, asides]

  # ── the agent under test ────────────────────────────
  - id: agent
    plugin: agent/vllm_omni
    config: {url: "${IG_AGENT_URL}", clock: input}

  # ── tasks and scoring ───────────────────────────────
  - id: tasks
    plugin: task/jsonl
    config: {path: tasks.jsonl}
  - id: timing
    plugin: scorer/timing

# ── change one row of a lower layer ───────────────────
- id: driver
  config: {concurrency: 16}
uv run ig run my_run.yml --seeds 0,1,2            # episodes.jsonl + viewer pages
uv run ig run my_run.yml --set agent.clock=realtime  # change one setting
uv run ig run my_run.yml --dump-config              # the resolved configuration
uv run ig run minimal                              # a built-in bundle, no GPU
